author: omarsaha05
quote: The game is truly amazing, and its open world is very good. The puzzles were very well-suited, and the age rating is appropriate for all kids and everyone, young and old. The events flowed well in sequence. The characters, the acting, the voices—everything was legendary in the literal sense; the game is complete.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: omarsaha05
